title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Disabled Persons Employment and Rehabilitation Amendment Act 2012

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Disabled Persons Employment and Rehabilitation Amendment Act 2012
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XVI OF 2012
ACT XVI OF 2012
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DISABLED PERSONS (EMPLOYMENT AND
REHABILITATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012
An Act to amend the Disabled Persons (Employment
and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa,
Extraordinary,
20th Setemper, 2012]
No.PA/Khyber Pakhtunkhwa/Bill/2012/6089, dated
20-9-2012.--The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Disabled Persons
(Employment and Rehabilitation) (Amendment) Bill, 2012 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 10th
September, 2012 and assented to by the Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 17th September, 2012 is hereby published as
an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Khyer Pakhtunkhwa.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Disabled Persons
(Employment and Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1981 (Ordinance No. XL of 1981), for
the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follow:
1. Short
title, extent and commencement.---(1) This Act may
be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Disabled Persons
(Employment and Rehabilitation) (Amendment) Act, 2012.
(2) It
extends to the whole of the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
(3) It
shall come into force at once.
